description: Official sing-box for Desktop (SFW) GUI. Nonportable NSIS system installer; requires an elevated shell and Scoop global mode.

script: if (!$global -or !(is_admin)) { throw 'SFW needs an elevated PowerShell and scoop install -g starry/sing-box-desktop' }
$installed = @($roots | ForEach-Object { Get-ItemProperty -Path $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -in @('sing-box', 'sing-box for Desktop') -and $_.UninstallString })
if ($installed.Count -gt 0) { throw 'sing-box for Desktop is already installed. Uninstall its WinGet/manual installation before switching management to Scoop.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $package -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'SFW installer is missing' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "SFW installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode)" }
if (!$global -or !(is_admin)) { throw 'SFW uninstall needs elevated PowerShell and scoop uninstall -g sing-box-desktop' }
$items = @($roots | ForEach-Object { Get-ItemProperty -Path $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -in @('sing-box', 'sing-box for Desktop') -and $_.UninstallString })
if ($items.Count -ne 1) { throw "Expected one registered sing-box uninstall entry; found $($items.Count). Refusing to uninstall another application." }
if (!$exe -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'SFW registered uninstaller not found; use Windows Settings > Installed apps.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "SFW uninstall failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode)" }

notes: NONPORTABLE: runs official NSIS machine installer; app files are placed in the installer-selected Windows location, not the Scoop directory.
Use elevated PowerShell and scoop install -g starry/sing-box-desktop.
If SFW is already installed via WinGet, uninstall it through WinGet first; back up your configuration and stop the app before migration.
Use scoop update -g sing-box-desktop to upgrade; exit SFW before updates. Scoop uninstall -g sing-box-desktop calls official Windows uninstaller and keeps application data by default.
The upstream installer does not support Scoop installation directory customization.
